primaryReference.wholePageRelationships: Broad sans opening -> authentic photographic story -> smaller personal photo album; menu and practical location inserted as distinct reading surfaces.
retainedProperties: One dominant image with secondary print-scale photos
Strong shift between photographic atmosphere and compact reading

supplementalReferences.problem: Pacing 116 genuine items while preserving compact source photo resolution
Asymmetric photo/text relationship for room story

sections.mechanism: Oversized broad sans heading establishes hierarchy; smaller photographic prints make a personal album beneath it.
sections.adaptation: Olive source palette and authentic house/interior/booth photographs, not barista imagery. The facade is central with smaller surrounding room views.
sections.rejected: Black surface, slogan, duplicated light/dark design, eyebrows and circular arrows.
sections.mobile: One-line factual Rumah tamah heading; central facade stays primary with overlapping smaller room/booth prints.

sections.mechanism: A bounded reading sheet, strong rules, two dense columns and compact name/price groups.
sections.adaptation: 8 products per replaceable page, shadcn Select and animated search over all 116 items; actual PDF dish crops remain small due to source resolution.
sections.rejected: Newspaper serif/masthead, fake featured claim, bright green, decorative heart and excessive taxonomy.
sections.mobile: Single leaf, same price/variant groups; search expands inline and Escape restores focus.

sections.mechanism: Image scale contrast followed by an interactive stack of photo prints.
sections.adaptation: One wide actual dining-room image, then small original booth/courtyard/vintage-furniture photographs with clickable thumbnail navigation.
sections.rejected: Long editorial prose, coral palette and invented testimonials; reference interactions are not verified.
sections.mobile: Wide room first, short factual heading next, then album beneath its action.

sections.mechanism: Restrained light/green surface transition gives the final practical information its own space.
sections.adaptation: Exact archived address, hours, WhatsApp, actual facade and Google Maps iframe.
sections.rejected: Decorative motif strips and unrelated mood-match feature.
sections.mobile: Address and hours above full-width map and fallback direction link.

comparison.closestDemo: Existing Bumi Upi demo; Duduk Gembira shares broad source-backed sans
structuralDifferences: Centered house album replaces serif split-product opening
Menu immediately follows opening; room and booth grouped after catalogue
Hero photo hierarchy is facade + side prints, not immersive photo hero or coffee-lab graphic panel
exceptions: Catalogue retains small product photos because original raster crops are around 105x60; names and prices remain dominant
comparison.limitation: Parent orchestrator owns full six-demo final render comparison. No claim this source inspection is visual comparison of all final demos.
